tools.name: ue4ss
tools.about: UE4SS v3.0.1-1152-ge3ba1016, the build Wax is tested on. Kept zipped; Build-WaxRelease.ps1 and Install-UE4SS.ps1 unpack it.

tools.name: pak\repak
tools.about: Pak pack/unpack CLI. Used by the build scripts.

tools.name: lua\lua54
tools.about: Standalone Lua 5.4, built from lua.org source with gcc. Same language version UE4SS embeds; runs the framework's offline tests. The sha256 is that of lua-5.4.8.tar.gz; change both together.

tools.name: lua\lua-language-server
tools.about: Lua language server: autocomplete and diagnostics in VS Code, and headless type-checking of mods (--check). One exact version, checked by its sha256; change the tag, the file name and the sha256 together.

tools.name: unreal\legendary
tools.about: Command-line Epic Games client. Used once by Install-UnrealEditor.ps1 to download Unreal Engine 4.27 into engine\. Its login lives in this folder's config\.
